info.title: Mawrid API
info.description: Buyer-side procure-to-pay for Saudi Arabia: requisitions, approvals, sealed RFQs, purchase orders, goods receipts and supplier invoices with ZATCA QR checks and a three-way match. Log in with POST /api/v1/auth/login and send the access token as a Bearer token.

Bearer.description: The access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login (valid 15 minutes).
